answer: I trust a proof kept by other hands, and Falconer redtail proof flown at the aerie is that proof: each redtail is a training record witnessed by the hawking clerk. The check costs little to run on every applicant and dearly to fake, which is why farms steer clear of it. Lock 85 POA away per mask and a farm of 249 masks has 21165 POA frozen before the epoch opens. One pass, one fare, one stamp: the horizon is the pass, the vertex is the fare, the cipher is the stamp — and stamps are never sold at any price.
